subject: Fix #7 - Make SERVER_VERSION open to all versions (#22)
reason: The change only edits build scripts and documentation: CMakeLists.txt gains a default for the VALKEY_VERSION cache variable, build.sh/run.sh stop rejecting SERVER_VERSION values other than 'unstable'/'8.0.0' and default it to 'unstable', and README/log messages are reworded. No module source code that affects runtime behaviour is touched (the src/CMakeLists.txt edit changes only a build-time message string), so the module binary built at the change behaves identically to the parent's; there is no command, reply, persistence or replication path to exercise, and a compared sequence could not leg
